name: claude-pace
description: Shows Claude subscription usage (session / weekly / per-model) with a marker for where usage would be at a steady pace.

claudePace.tolerance.description: Percentage points around the pace marker that still count as "on pace".

claudePace.endpoint.enabled.description: Poll Anthropic's undocumented OAuth usage endpoint using Claude Code's login. Provides per-model limits such as Fable and works without an active session.

claudePace.endpoint.intervalSeconds.description: How often to poll the usage endpoint.

claudePace.file.path.description: File written by scripts/statusline.js. Empty means <claude config dir>/pace/rate_limits.json.
